chunks: Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding the pebbles of the Jamarah.
He said: The solid (single-structured) ones from it are disliked. And he said: Take the multi-colored ones.

key_terms.الصُّمُّ: The solid/monolithic (referring to pebbles that are single-structured or from a large solid rock, as opposed to small separate stones)
key_terms.الْبُرْشَ: The multi-colored (referring to pebbles with mixed colors, preferred for the ritual)
key_terms.حَصَى الْجِمَارِ: Pebbles of the Jamarah (stones used in the ritual of stoning the devil pillars during Hajj)

ai.seo_question: What is the preferred type of pebble for Jamarah pelting according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) distinguishes between pebbles that are solid and single-structured, which are disliked, and those that are multi-colored (bursh), which are recommended for the Jamarah ritual. This preference for 'bursh' reflects the scholarly emphasis on selecting pebbles that are distinct and easily identifiable, ensuring the ritual is performed with precision and reverence. The ruling underscores the importance of adhering to specific physical characteristics in acts of worship to maintain their spiritual integrity.
